tasks.command: rm -rf /tmp/axiom-sandbox && mkdir -p /tmp/axiom-sandbox && echo '{"dependencies":{"react-native":"*","expo":"*"}}' > /tmp/axiom-sandbox/package.json && echo '{"compilerOptions":{"paths":{"@/*":["./src/*"]}}}' > /tmp/axiom-sandbox/tsconfig.json && bun packages/cli/src/index.ts init --styling stylesheet --no-install --registry packages/registry --cwd /tmp/axiom-sandbox | cat
